subject: SLA uplift & regional burst plan for renewal (Waypoint Health)
messages:
From: Eleanor Park <eleanor@waypointhealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@waypointhealth.com, tom.willis@waypointhealth.com
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: request to discuss premium SLA and regional burst capacity

Hi Jasmine,

Hope you’re well — our renewal for Redwood inference is up in Q3 and Procurement asked us to formalize a higher SLO for latency (95th percentile target) and to secure regional burst capacity across us-east-1 and eu-west-1 for peak traffic. We ran a small pilot during the last quarter and saw tail latency spikes during our nightly batch runs; we'd like an explicit improved SLO and some burst credits for the first 3 months post-renewal.

Attached is our RFP excerpt outlining requirements and a short traffic profile. Can we get a proposal outlining:
- Proposed Premium SLA targets and failure credits
- Regional burst capacity (how many tokens/sec or reserved burst units) and on-call response SLAs
- Pricing delta and any onboarding timeline

Available for a call next Wednesday or Thursday (PDT). Thanks, and copying Procurement for visibility.

Attachments: [Attachment: Waypoint_RFP_Q3.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)]

Best,
Eleanor Park
Director, ML Platform
Waypoint Health
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor@waypointhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 19 Jun 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: request to discuss premium SLA and regional burst capacity

Eleanor — thanks for sending the RFP excerpt, helpful context. We can absolutely support a tailored Premium SLA and a regional burst plan.

Quick proposal:
- Premium SLA: 95th percentile latency target of 120ms for gen endpoints across pinned models, with an availability SLO of 99.95%. Failure credits tied to both availability and latency regressions.
- Regional burst: reserve 2x baseline throughput in us-east-1 and 1.5x in eu-west-1 for 90-day post-renewal window; automatic failover to adjacent region with documented fallback policy.
- Ops/onboarding: 4–6 week runbook + KV-prefix cache warmup, with a one-week high-touch run to tune batching and quantization profiles.

I’ve looped in Ben (pricing) and Laura (AM) to get numbers and a formal addendum prepared. Would you prefer a live walkthrough early next week? Thursday 10am PDT works for us.

If that aligns, we’ll prepare an SLA addendum and a draft DocuSign for signatures.

— Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine_liu@redwood.com]
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2029 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing + credits for Waypoint Premium SLA (internal)

Jasmine / Laura — following up from Eleanor’s ask. Numbers I suggest we bring to the call:
- Premium SLA uplift: +18% on baseline per-token rate, or a flat monthly retainer option (preferred by enterprise) of $18k/month for the guardrails we discussed.
- Burst credits: provide a pool equivalent to ~120M tokens usable over 90 days (auto-burst until pool depletes), with per-use overage rate at 65% of standard on-demand.
- Onboarding: one-time professional services fee $12k (4-week engagement) or included if they commit to 12 months.

Risks / negotiation levers:
- We can trade a shorter latency SLO (e.g., 150ms) for fewer credits.
- Offer a 3-month performance credit if we miss latency SLO more than twice in a quarter.

Priyom — can you confirm ops capacity to guarantee a one-week high-touch tuning window post-sign? If yes, I’ll draft the SLA addendum.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor@waypointhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 7 Jul 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: request to discuss premium SLA and regional burst capacity

Eleanor — appreciate the conversation last week. Summarizing the proposal and next steps so we’re aligned before I send the addendum and DocuSign link: 

What we’ll deliver as part of the Renewal Addendum:
- Premium SLA: 95th percentile latency target = 120ms (gen endpoints) + availability SLO = 99.95%. Failure credits: standard escalator (service credit ladder, up to 30% of monthly retainer).
- Regional burst pool: 120M tokens usable across us-east-1 and eu-west-1 over 90 days post-renewal. Auto-burst enabled; overflow routes per the failover policy in the addendum.
- Onboarding & tuning: one-week high-touch tuning immediately after signature, plus a 4-week runbook delivery. Ops contact: Priyom Das (priyom_das@redwood.com).
- Pricing: proposed retainer of $17,500/month (12 month minimum) + one-time onboarding credit waiver if signed within 30 days. Alternative: +15% per-token uplift if they prefer no retainer.
- Remedies: two latency misses in a rolling quarter triggers a rollback credit; three misses open a remediation sprint and enhanced credits.

Attachments: SLA addendum draft attached for review. DocuSign link will be provided once you sign off on wording.

Next steps: please confirm acceptance of the targets and pricing model and I’ll send the DocuSign. If you want any changes to the failure credit ladder or regional allocation, flag them and we’ll adjust. Proposed sign-by date to lock pricing: July 31, 2029.

Attachments: [Attachment: SLA_Addendum_Waypoint_v1.pdf (PDF, 4 pages)]

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping this up.

— Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
